text:
Samir (partnerships): Quick update — StrataSecure just converted from pilot to a 2yr Dedicated commitment and will list our Private/Dedicated connector in the Azure Marketplace next week. Pilot went GA last quarter and they saw clear infra cost wins. :tada:

Tess (marketing): Amazing news! Can you drop their approved logo + a one‑pager? We’ll prep blog + social amplification.

Hugo (sales): FYI renewal/upgrade is $1.2M ARR net new to Dedicated. AE is Hugo. Onboarding kickoff scheduled Wed 10am PT — I’ll send invites.

Maria (solutions): I’ll own SSO + KMS handoff. Need StrataSecure tenant IDs and primary infra contact. @Samir can you DM those?

Ops-bot: Onboarding ticket created: ONB-4719 — assigned to eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/ONB-4719

Jordan (product): Nice work. Can we get a short customer quote for the case study about latency/cost improvements? 30–50 words is fine.

Samir (partnerships): They agreed to a quote about ~35% per-token cost reduction after batching + prefix/KV caching. I'll confirm exact wording with their infra lead tomorrow.

Legal - Rose: Heads up — contract amendment required for Dedicated term + marketplace listing. PO still pending. Samir, I’ll ping procurement and request the signed PO.

Tess (marketing): Draft case study in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/stratasecure-case-study — please add quotes, logos, and a technical callout (quantization + KV cache results) by EOD Fri.

Hugo (sales): Also prepping an exec thank-you cadence. @Tess can you own external comms? I’ll coordinate customer attendees.

Maya (customer success): Happy to join the kickoff to capture adoption metrics and help with the quote.

Samir (partnerships): Assigning owners: Hugo — customer comms, Maria — SSO/KMS, Maya — success metrics, Eng-oncall — onboarding. Thanks everyone. Big win for our Private + Marketplace GTM.

Tess (marketing): :confetti_ball: will do. Calendar hold created for webinar spotlight, pending legal sign-off.

Ops-bot: Reminder: onboarding template: /docs/onboarding-dedicated.md and checklist linked in ticket ONB-4719.

Samir (partnerships): Quick FYI for product folks — StrataSecure agreed to be featured in an Apr 7 webinar spotlight (Private + Marketplace use case) if legal clears the marketing assets. :sparkles:

Hugo (sales): Congrats team — huge step for our enterprise pipeline.

Maria (solutions): Congrats! Sending tenant IDs in DM.

Legal - Rose: Pinged procurement. Expect PO this week.

Samir (partnerships): Closing thread — please drop any final assets or short congrats here. If anyone wants to add a short technical blurb for the case study, drop it in the Confluence draft.

Tess (marketing): GIFs encouraged :partyparrot:

Maya (customer success): Congrats all!

Jordan (product): Great job.

Ops-bot: Ticket ONB-4719 status: In progress.
